summary: Anticipatory bail vs absconding accused; Sections 82/83 Cr.PC proclamation disentitles relief; pre-arrest bail application dismissal upheld where accused declared proclaimed offender; Lavesh and Pradeep Sharma precedents applied; exceptional circumstances standard for Section 438 Cr.PC not met; pending bail application cannot override proclamation proceedings.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act, 1999 s.3, s.4
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's dismissal of anticipatory bail upheld; appellants not entitled to pre-arrest bail as declared absconders.
